expected_observable_behavior.zh: 转速、转矩、动作时间随配方 R-A/R-B/R-C 明显分层。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Speed, torque, and durations shift by recipe R-A/R-B/R-C.

ground_truth.zh: 三种已知配方随机切换；无故障。
ground_truth.en: Three known recipes switch randomly; no faults.

expected_health_response.zh: 工况归一化后全部 NORMAL；不按工况区分会误报。
expected_health_response.en: NORMAL after regime normalization; regime-unaware checks would false-alarm.

abstention_cases.zh: 无强制弃权；空闲/停机窗口不评估健康状态。
abstention_cases.en: No mandatory abstention; idle/stopped windows are not assessed.
